limits: Batch errors estimate finite event and shower sampling; channel-beta/integration uncertainties are separate. Independent source campaigns differ in source generation and continuation; a drift comparison alone is not a controlled causal test. Delta-method Gaussian inference is unreliable in sparse bins and is not reported when either H transfer is unsampled.
method: 50 matching contiguous LHE chunks and numerically ordered shower jobs; four inclusive weights verified per chunk; delta-method paired H/S ratio influence functions
